todos.title: Execute `cargo build` and resolve all compilation errors
Execute `cargo clippy -- -D warnings` and fix all lint errors/warnings
Audit production code for `unwrap()` usage, replace with proper error handling (exclude tests/benchmarks)
Execute `cargo test --all-features` and fix all failing unit, integration, and benchmark tests
Verify crash recovery tests (WAL truncation, SSTable corruption) pass
Execute `cargo audit` and resolve critical/high unrecognized vulnerabilities
Execute `workflow-agent` to validate all non-secret CI jobs in ci.yml, fix failures
Verify module-specific lint and tests pass (post-#93 refactor)
